title: ClearPath Managed IT Services: One Agreement per Client Organisation
content:
**Rule.** A client organisation holds at most one ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement at a time (a maximum of 1 per client). Every user, site and device the client wants managed is covered under that single agreement, and a move between tiers is a tier change on the existing agreement, never a second agreement.

**Signing condition.** A new agreement may be signed only when the client holds no other ClearPath agreement whose status is applied, onboarding, active, suspended, notice given or offboarding. The test is made before signing, on the company's system record of the client's agreements, matched by the client's own reference number; it is the status shown on those records that counts.

**Closed and cancelled agreements.** A closed or cancelled agreement does not block a new one. A returning client signs a new agreement with a new term and a new onboarding fee assessment.

| Status of the client's existing ClearPath agreement | Blocks a new agreement |
|---|---|
| No agreement on record | No |
| Applied, onboarding, active, suspended, notice given or offboarding | Yes |
| Closed | No |
| Cancelled | No |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- A client whose only agreement shows notice given cannot sign a second agreement while that status stands; adding sites or users is done under the existing agreement.
- A client whose earlier agreement shows closed signs a new agreement, which starts a new term and is assessed a new onboarding fee under the onboarding fee rules of the tier signed.
